Thousands of Anthropic Employees and Investors Are Set to Reap Fortunes

Majority of AI frontier lab’s more than 5,000 employees are expected to become millionaires

By

Anthropic’s ANT 17.07 % increase; up pointing triangle initial public offering is set to deliver windfalls across Silicon Valley—and the celebratory toasts are already in the works.

The frontier lab’s stock-market debut is expected to mint thousands of new millionaires among the Anthropic employees who helped transform the startup into an artificial-intelligence powerhouse. Venture-capital firms that bet on the onetime underdog are also set to win big.
